subject: Business Models
title: AI Agents as Businesses
description: One-minute skill: AI Agents as Businesses.

hook.text: An AI agent can now book flights, file taxes, and manage your calendar. What happens when AI runs entire businesses?

buildup.text: AI agents perform tasks autonomously: researching, writing, coding, and making decisions without human input.

discovery.text: Solo entrepreneurs now use AI agents to handle marketing, support, and operations—running as a one-person company.

twist.text: If AI can run a business, who is the entrepreneur? The person who prompts the AI or the AI that does the work?

climax.text: AI agents could create millions of micro-businesses. The cost to start a company is approaching zero.

punchline.text: AI runs the business. You wrote the prompt. Starting a company costs near $0.

quiz.question: How are AI agents changing entrepreneurship?
options: Enabling one-person companies to handle operations previously needing teams
